title: Product lockup + CTA
description: Transactional voucher journeys where the user needs one-tap access to their offer.
usage: Header for voucher / offer journeys. FreeStyle Libre 3 Plus lockup with a persistent utility CTA. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.

images.notes: FreeStyle Libre 3 Plus lockup, charcoal type. Transparent PNG, contain.
Same lockup with white type, shown via mfs-dark-img.

notes: Desktop: logo left, yellow CTA right. Mobile: both stack and centre (mfs-stack + mfs-center + mfs-auto), 8px apart (mfs-pt2).
Figma's mobile vertical padding grows to 24px (token 4) from 16px on desktop; mfs-py4 is used on top of the 16px inline value because its mobile override is exactly 24px.
Yellow button is the same in both modes (no dm classes). VML width 216px.
Logo light/dark swap needs the head CSS; clients without it (Outlook.com dark, Gmail) keep the charcoal lockup.
